description: The plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” illustrates how training loss changes over optimization steps for six model configurations (ChemBART Small/Medium, ChemBERTa Small/Medium, and ChemLLaMA Small/Medium) trained with a 20M data size. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and is shown with a broken axis: the main segment spans from 0K to 80K with labeled ticks at 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, and 80K, and a second segment spans roughly 420K to 440K with labeled ticks at 420K, 430K, and 440K. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 up to about 0.85, with labeled ticks including 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six series are drawn as thin solid lines without visible point markers and show a steep early decrease followed by a slower decline with small high-frequency fluctuations; the ChemBART Small 20M line (red) starts near the upper portion of the axis (around the 0.8 region) and trends downward to around the low 0.1 range by ~80K, then appears around a few hundredths in the 420K–440K segment; the ChemBART Medium 20M line (blue) follows a similar shape, descending from the upper range near the start to around the low 0.1 range by ~80K and to a few hundredths by ~440K; the ChemBERTa Small 20M line (green) also drops rapidly early and then gradually, sitting around the mid-to-low 0.1 range by ~80K and around a few hundredths by ~440K; the ChemBERTa Medium 20M line (orange) decreases in the same pattern, reaching roughly the low 0.1 range by ~80K and a few hundredths by ~440K; the ChemLLaMA Small 20M line (purple) declines from the upper start region to around the ~0.1 region by ~80K and to a few hundredths by ~440K; and the ChemLLaMA Medium 20M line (brown) shows the same overall downward trajectory, ending in the few-hundredths range in the 420K–440K segment.
